svg.title: Private LLM inference on EKS: how it is deployed, operated and used
svg.text: Private LLM inference on EKS: how it is deployed, operated and used
Four paths: deploy (git to AWS), operate (SSO to bastion to cluster), request (client to model), observe (metrics to Grafana)
1 Deploy path: from the laptop into AWS (all code in git)
2 Operate path: how an operator reaches a private cluster (no inbound ports, no SSH keys)
3 Request path: a question in, an answer out (only from inside the VPC)
IRSA role: s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on the
models bucket only. No long-lived credentials.
4 Observability path: metrics and the dashboard
No IGW, no NAT, internal ALB
Taint: only GPU pods on GPU node
